{{Quote|''I know this world is not yours, that our people are not your people. But if you will aid us, you will always have a place of honor among the Nazren."|Sartok|<ref name="First to Strike" />}}
'''Sartok''' was a charismatic [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nazren]], who was leader of the [[Nizon resistance]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

An older member of his species, Sartok was missing the second and fourth fingers from his left hand, and he had several scars, including some across his face. He was a darker shade of brown than most of his brethren, with lighter splotches of skin at his wrinkles and creases.

After [[Nizon]], the Nazren homeworld, was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Sartok tried to free his people. He was eventually able to do so during the [[Battle of Nizon]], with the help of some agents working for the [[Alderaanian Resistance]].
